item.title: Yankees set to retire CC Sabathia’s number
item.description: The New York Yankees announced on Tuesday that Sabathia's former number of 52 with the team will be retired on Sept. 26 in a game against the Baltimore Orioles. A plaque in his honor is also set to be dedicated prior to the game that day.

item.title: Danette Mitchell: The life and times of the Rev. Jesse Jackson
item.description: Rev. Jackson left lessons we can learn from, especially for young people, so that they feel inspired and prepared to carry the torch forward, addressing civil rights, economic justice, environmental, and health issues.
